description: This file defines classes related to Airties Ethernet Interface TLV structures, including tlvAirtiesEthernetInterface and cInterfaceList, with methods for parsing, creating, and manipulating Ethernet interface data.

classes.name: tlvAirtiesEthernetInterface
classes.description: Represents an Airties Ethernet Interface TLV with methods for parsing and managing interface data.

classes.name: cInterfaceList
classes.description: Represents a list of Ethernet interface details, including MAC address and interface name.
